expected_contradictions.description: The good-standing certificate is 420 days old; it is valid for 12 months and nobody asked for a new one.
The SBLC expires before the trading period, the payment term and the claim window end; the credit memo says it covers the full term.
Harbourline's email says its only change is late interest, but its redline also moves payment from 30 to 45 days. NewCo's reply repeats that payment stays at 30 days.
